title: Two Points of View · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Two Points of View · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a simple fictional event involving two characters. The lead describes the event once from each character's viewpoint. Both descriptions refer to the same event and identify different viewpoints. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Two Points of View, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
Both descriptions refer to the same event and identify different viewpoints.
recall.why: Both descriptions refer to the same event and identify different viewpoints.
